user.title: Correct a PV forecast
user.description: Pick the forecast to correct and the sensor that measures what your panels produce. The forecast keeps its shape; only its level is adjusted from the measured production. More settings are in the options after setup.

data_description.name: Name of the device; the sensors are named after it.
data_description.forecast_today: Sensor with a forecast list in the Solcast format (attribute detailedForecast or detailedHourly), e.g. Solcast's "Forecast today".
data_description.forecast_tomorrow: The same for tomorrow. Needed by consumers that plan the night.
data_description.actual_energy: Energy meter of the PV production in kWh (may reset daily). Preferred. Use either this or power sensors.
data_description.actual_power: One or more PV power sensors; they are added up and integrated. Use either these or an energy meter.
data_description.curtailment: Optional: on while the output is limited (export limit, derating). Those intervals are left out of every ratio.

error.invalid_forecast: This entity has no forecast list in the Solcast format (detailedForecast or detailedHourly with period_start and pv_estimate).
error.same_forecast: Today and tomorrow must be different entities.
error.actual_missing: Select an energy meter or at least one power sensor for the production.
error.actual_both: Select either an energy meter or power sensors, not both.

abort.already_configured: This forecast is already corrected by another entry.

init.title: PV Forecast Correction
init.description: Changes take effect immediately; the learned history is kept.

inputs.name: Inputs
inputs.description: Forecast to correct and measured production.

data_description.forecast_today: Sensor with a forecast list in the Solcast format.
data_description.actual_energy: Energy meter in kWh (may reset daily). Either this or power sensors.
data_description.actual_power: PV power sensors, added up. Either these or an energy meter.
data_description.curtailment: On while the output is limited; those intervals are not learned from.

level.name: Level factor
level.description: Scales the whole forecast by measured ÷ forecast energy of the last days. The base forecast's own dampening stays untouched; this only removes the remaining bias.

data_description.level_enabled: Off: the factor is still computed and shown, but not applied.
data_description.level_days: Number of complete past days in the ratio.
data_description.level_shrink_days: Days at ratio 1.0 added to the ratio, so a fresh install starts neutral and gets close to the learned value within the first week.
data_description.level_min: The factor never goes below this.
data_description.level_max: The factor never goes above this.
data_description.level_by_time: Learns a factor for every hour of the day from the same days, so hours that regularly run below or above the rest of the day (morning fog, low sun) are corrected on their own. Hours with little energy stay close to the day factor.

fog.name: Fog layer
fog.description: On days when a whole morning runs far below a confident forecast (fog, low stratus), scales the rest of the day down by the measured ratio. Shadow mode computes and shows it without changing the forecast.

data_description.fog_mode: Off, shadow (computed and shown only) or on (applied).
data_description.fog_threshold: The layer opens when the morning and the recent window both produced less than this share of the forecast.
data_description.fog_min_confidence: Additionally requires the base forecast's P10 ÷ P50 for the day to be at least this (a narrow, confident forecast). 0 switches this condition off.
data_description.fog_min_factor: The fog factor never goes below this.

archive.name: Archive
archive.description: Keeps every base forecast, the measured energy and the applied factors in a file in the config directory, so any variant can be evaluated later (tools/replay.py).

data_description.archive_retention_days: Older data is deleted every night.

error.invalid_forecast: This entity has no forecast list in the Solcast format.
error.same_forecast: Today and tomorrow must be different entities.
error.actual_missing: Select an energy meter or at least one power sensor for the production.
error.actual_both: Select either an energy meter or power sensors, not both.
error.level_bounds: The lowest level factor must be below the highest.

state.no_band: Needs P10 in the forecast, which is missing
state.active: Active: morning far below a confident forecast

export.name: Export archive
export.description: Writes the archive of an entry as CSV files into the config directory (pv_forecast_correction/export).

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The PV Forecast Correction entry to export.

reset.name: Reset learning
reset.description: Forgets the learned days; the level factor starts neutral again.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The PV Forecast Correction entry to reset.

learn_from_history.name: Learn from history
learn_from_history.description: Learns the level factor from the recorder: measured energy per day from the long-term statistics of the production inputs, and the forecast's day total as it stood before production began. Days the integration measured itself are kept. Useful right after installation.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The PV Forecast Correction entry that learns.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many past days to read.

forecast_power.name: Forecast power now
forecast_power.description: Optional: a sensor that shows the base forecast's power for the current moment (Solcast: Power Now). Its hourly statistics give the forecast per hour: more exact, and the time-of-day curve can be learned at once.

entry_not_loaded.message: The selected entry is not loaded.

archive_disabled.message: The archive is disabled or could not be opened.

recorder_unavailable.message: The recorder is not available, so there is no history to learn from.

forecast_unavailable.title: Base forecast cannot be read
forecast_unavailable.description: The forecast of {entity_id} could not be read for more than an hour ({detail}). The correction keeps using the last forecast it had. Check the base forecast integration or change the input in the options.

actual_unavailable.title: Production cannot be read
actual_unavailable.description: The production sensor {entity_id} could not be read for more than an hour ({detail}). Intervals without readings are not learned from. Check the sensor or change the input in the options.
